source.title: Work Smarter, Not Harder
source.description:
Ever since the eruptions started we've been fighting tooth and nail to keep these blasted elementals down and the work has taken its toll on our craftsmen. Turns out, keeping the troops' gear and kit in tip-top shape is a lot of work. Fortunately, us dwarves are the masters of working smarter, not harder and we've discovered that the power cores inside of the Obsidian Surgers to the southeast of Thorium Point can be put to great use as whetstones to easily hone our blades!

Would you fetch more for us?
source.objective: Taskmaster Scrange wants you to slay Obsidian Surgers in the Searing Gorge and bring their Power Cores back him. Obsidian Surgers can be found along the southern portion of the Searing Gorge, near the entrance to Blackrock Mountain.
